prompt:
A battle background for a side-on JRPG battle scene (the party will stand on the right, monsters on the left; no characters are drawn), in rich high-resolution 2D pixel art. The world is in an endless night: the sun has vanished and people live by lamplight. Setting: the bottom of oblivion, the place under the world where forgotten, endless stories sink. Back (top 42%): an ink-black void with no sky, torn white tears and rips in the darkness like ripped paper edges, countless loose white pages and open books drifting and sinking slowly in the air, fragments of forgotten places floating upside down far away (a broken staircase, a door frame, a piece of a town wall, a chair), all pale, grey and drained of colour, with faint violet edges. Ground (lower 58%): a vast floating floor made of huge pale paper-white stone slabs with faint ruled lines and torn edges, drifts of blank pages, broken quills and a few cracked slabs at the sides, the edges of the floor crumbling into the void far away. Light: a cold faint white glow from the pages, ink-black and grey-violet, almost monochrome with one faint violet tint. The ground plane recedes from the bottom edge up to the horizon line at a low 3/4 angle; the middle of the ground (from 55% to 90% of the height, centre and right) is open, fairly flat and uncluttered: space for the battle. Details (rocks, plants, debris) sit at the sides and far away. 
No lantern, no fire in the middle, no people, no monsters, no text, no UI.
Pixel art: every art pixel is 4x4 image pixels (the image is 960 x 540 art pixels), crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, hue-shifted colour ramps (shadows toward violet, lights toward warm yellow), clusters with clear shapes, not a painting.

Party placement will be on the right and enemies on the left, but DRAW NO CHARACTERS. World of endless night beneath the world: 'bottom of oblivion', where forgotten endless stories sink. Upper 42%: utterly ink-black void, no sky or stars; torn irregular WHITE paper-like rips and tears in the darkness, loose white pages and open books suspended drifting and sinking, distant tiny upside-down fragments of forgotten places (broken staircase, empty door frame, piece of town wall, chair), bleached pale grey with fine violet shadowed edges. Lower 58%: vast floating floor of huge pale paper-white stone slabs, delicate faint ruled lines and torn chipped paper edges, sparse drifts of blank pages and broken quills, a few cracked slabs confined to sides, distant edge crumbling into void. Low three-quarter viewing angle, ground recedes from bottom edge toward distant horizon. PRESERVE broad flat readable uncluttered central and right battle zone from y=55% to y=90%, nothing prominent on it. Scenic debris stays to far sides and far background. Illumination by faint cold white glow from paper; near-monochrome ink black, pale ivory, grey and grey-violet, barely perceptible violet hue, muted slightly warm yellow in palest highlights and violet-shifted shadow ramps. Evocative desolate atmospheric fantasy game backdrop; strong silhouette design, carefully placed clustered texture. NO lantern, no fire, no people, no monsters, no text, no interface, no UI.
